'''C fire 4''' was the callsign for a pilot that fought in the [[Battle of Calamari]] in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
C fire 4 did not manage to pull his fighter out of a dive and crashed during the battle.
